name: draggable-card
blurb: 3D card that responds to pointer movement and drag gestures.
description: A card that tilts and rotates toward the pointer via motion values, scales on hover, and can be dragged across the viewport with physics-based momentum. 3D perspective effects apply during interaction.
use_when: Hero showcases, attention-grabbing modals, or interactive product presentations where tactile, 3D feedback enhances engagement.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces or contexts where drag interactions might conflict with page scrolling.
a11y: Draggable via motion library with cursor feedback (grabbing state). No prefers-reduced-motion guard; 3D effects apply uniformly.
